posts.title: Time beyond our time

posts.title: Cherry Tree Surrender
posts.description: I planted this Lapins Cherry seven years ago, and did all kinds of care for it over the years. Holistic sprays, pruning, copper spray this spring. posts.title: Tree frog tadpoles
posts.description: With the heat, and the need to tend the vegetables, I’ve rather neglected the pond this year. I haven’t spent as many hours just sitting nearby looking for frogs and enjoying the plants. Today I walked back to take a look, and discovered that we have tadpoles!
